title: Cross-department students
statementMd:
List students enrolled in courses from at least four different departments.

Expected columns: `name`, `departments`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT s.name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.department) AS departments FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.id JOIN courses c ON c.id = e.course_id GROUP BY s.id, s.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.department) >= 4;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
